verdict.rationale: The evidence pack ties skills.sh to the open Agent Skills spec at agentskills.io, which defines SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter, a `skills-ref validate` tool, and cross-product reuse 'across any skills-compatible agent'. The CLI scaffolds SKILL.md templates and installs the same skill folder into 70+ agents from different vendors (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode), and a community comment praises the agent-agnostic approach. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that `skills init` templates conform to the spec, validation built into the CLI, and independent hands-on confirmation that one skill folder works across vendors.
